description: 📌 Checkmyguest offers this beautiful 120 m² duplex in the heart of Paris’s 2nd arrondissement, ideal for accommodating up to 12 people in a comfortable and functional setting.Enjoy a central location near the Grands Boulevards, Montorgueil, and numerous shops, restaurants, and public transportation options, making it easy to explore the capital.The space⭐ Welcome to this 120 m² duplex in the heart of Paris’s 2nd arrondissement, ideally located near the Grands Boulevards, Porte Saint-Denis, and the lively Montorgueil neighborhood.📍 A prime location in the heart of ParisSet in a lively and central neighborhood, this apartment lets you fully enjoy the Parisian atmosphere. You’ll be just a short walk from the Grands Boulevards, Porte Saint-Denis, and numerous shops, restaurants, cafés, and boutiques. The famous Montorgueil neighborhood, known for its bustling streets, food shops, and numerous outdoor dining areas, is also nearby.Located on the ground floor, it consists of:Level 0✔️ A cozy living room with two sofa beds, a TV, and a dining table—perfect for sharing meals.✔️ A fully equipped open kitchen: refrigerator, freezer, stovetop, microwave, kettle, coffee maker, toaster, oven… You’ll have everything you need to prepare your meals and enjoy a self-catering stay.✔️ A bathroom equipped with a shower, sink, and toilet.In the basement✔️ A living area with a sofa bed✔️ A comfortable bedroom with a queen-size bed and a TV.✔️ A second bedroom with two queen-size beds.✔️ A bathroom equipped with a shower, sink, and toilet.✔️ A bathroom with a shower and a sink.✔️ A separate toilet.✔️ There is a washer and dryer in the apartment.📍 Highlights of the apartment:📶 Wi-Fi internet connection to stay connected during your stay.🧺 A washing machine is available for added convenience, es
